visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, a light grey tank top, and an open white shirt sits facing the camera. Behind her, a man with a black cap, tinted sunglasses, and a black T-shirt holds a large, textured beige blanket with both hands. The setting is indoors, featuring a well-lit wooden shelving unit displaying several pairs of high-heeled shoes and sneakers, with warm studio lighting highlighting the textures. (2) The man tosses the beige blanket directly toward the camera lens with a swift motion, momentarily obscuring the entire frame with the fabric's rough, woven texture. The movement is rapid, creating a sense of a physical transition within the frame. (3) The blanket is pulled away to reveal a role-swapped scene: the man is now seated in the foreground chair, wrapped tightly in the beige blanket up to his neck, while the woman stands behind him, leaning in and smiling at the camera. The background shelves remain the same, providing continuity to the setting. (4) The woman repeats the action of throwing the beige blanket over the camera lens to black out the view once more, creating another physical transition. The fabric covers the lens completely for a brief moment, acting as a manual wipe transition between scenes. (5) The blanket is removed to show the original positions again, but the woman is now wearing a pink zip-up hoodie over her grey top. The man stands behind her, smiling brightly and gesturing with a firm thumbs-up to the camera.
